definitions.explanation: A performance or show presented to the public, typically in a theater or concert hall. Used for plays, musicals, concerts, ballet, and other staged performances.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}の{公演|こうえん}は{満席|まんせき}だ。
この{劇団|げきだん}は{来月|らいげつ}から{全国|ぜんこく}{公演|こうえん}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: This theater company will hold nationwide performances starting next month.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}なバレエ{団|だん}の{公演|こうえん}を{見|み}に{行|い}ったが、{期待|きたい}どおり{素晴|すば}らしかった。
examples.english: I went to see a performance by a famous ballet company, and it was wonderful, just as I expected.

notes:
Used for staged artistic performances. Not used for informal live performances or street performances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{公演|こうえん}を{行|おこな}う (hold a performance)
・{公演|こうえん}を{見|み}に{行|い}く (go to see a performance)
・{全国|ぜんこく}{公演|こうえん} (nationwide tour/performances)
・{初|はつ}{公演|こうえん} (first/premiere performance)
・{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく} (final performance of a run)
・{公演|こうえん}{中止|ちゅうし} (performance cancellation)

Note the homophone {公園|こうえん} (park), which has the same reading but different kanji and meaning.
